definitions.explanation: Reproducing or reposting content (articles, images, text) that was originally published elsewhere. Often used regarding copyright and permission issues online.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧{転載|てんさい}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{転載|てんさい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{転載|てんさい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{著作権|ちょさくけん}→著作権：14022_chosakuken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Reposting someone else's photos without permission can lead to copyright issues.

notes:
USAGE:
{転載|てんさい} refers specifically to reproducing or reposting content from one medium or platform to another. It is commonly seen in copyright notices on websites and publications.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{転載|てんさい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to repost/reprint something)
- ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{転載|てんさい} (reprint from...)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧{転載|てんさい} (unauthorized reproduction)
- {転載|てんさい}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (reproduction prohibited)
- ⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{転載|てんさい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (repost an article)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{転載|てんさい} focuses on reproducing content across platforms. Compare with ⟦{引用|いんよう}→引用：01850_inyou⟧ (quotation), which refers to citing a portion of someone's work with attribution.
